newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- McDonald's Q2 estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- McDonald's Q2 estimate cut.

text.p: EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it lowered its earnings estimate for McDonald's Corp's 1997 second quarter based on a 7.5 percent decline in same store sales in the first 21 days of June and a 6.2 percent fall in May.

However, EVEREN analyst Dean Haskell said June results are only partial and full-month numbers could change. McDonald's Hercules promotion has begun and could increase sales in the final week as the movie is released today, he said.
Haskell trimmed 1997 second quarter earnings estimates to $0.63 a share from $0.65, according to a report.
Haskell maintains his market performer rating on McDonald's stock but is advising investors to avoid buying the shares until the fast food company's sales and profit problems are resolved.
Shares of McDonald's were trading off 3/8 at 48-1/2.
